basic_info.description: Experience Manhattan-level luxury in this striking 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condominium at the historic Capo Di Monte on Russian Hill(soon to be featured in the upcoming Seth Rogen and Olivia Wilde film The Invite''!) Soaring high ceilings and exquisite architectural details create dramatic spaces reminiscent of New York's finest residences. This sophisticated home features deeded bonus space providing endless possibilities, home office, den, or creative studio plus additional storage for seamless city living. Premium parking included in this A+ building ensures the ultimate urban convenience. Perched on one of San Francisco's most coveted hills, you're moments from North Beach's vibrant dining scene, Fisherman's Wharf, and the city's cultural heart. This is where New York Style meets California cool, offering the cosmopolitan lifestyle you crave with San Francisco's unmatched charm. Live the high-rise dream with small-building intimacy at Capo Di Monte.   https://2111Hyde-301.com/mls
